1. The HydroSense service
HydroSense is a water monitoring and system-control application. Depending on your hardware, network connection, account, and enabled features, the app may display pH, total dissolved solids (TDS), turbidity, tank level, tank distance, leak or moisture status, pump status, pump runtime, and related system information. It may also allow authorized users to send commands to connected pumps or other supported equipment and may provide filter-life estimates.

The service requires compatible hardware, a working internet connection, Firebase authentication and database services, and correctly configured equipment. Group 1 may change, suspend, or discontinue features as the service develops.

2. Eligibility and account responsibility

You are responsible for providing accurate registration information, keeping your sign-in credentials confidential, and all activity performed through your account. Tell Group 1 promptly if you believe your account or connected equipment has been accessed without permission. Do not share access in a way that could allow an unauthorized person to operate connected equipment.

3. Hardware control and safety
HydroSense is a convenience and monitoring aid, not an emergency, industrial, medical, fire, flood, life-safety, or water-treatment safety system. Do not rely on the app as the only protection against leaks, overflowing tanks, pump failure, contamination, electrical hazards, or other damage.

Before using remote control or automated operation, inspect the installation and confirm that pumps, valves, sensors, wiring, power supplies, tanks, filters, and physical safety devices are correctly installed and maintained. Keep appropriate local safety shutoffs available. You are responsible for supervising operation when necessary and for stopping equipment when conditions are unsafe.

Commands may be delayed, duplicated, rejected, unavailable, or shown with a delay because of internet, Firebase, power, sensor, firmware, device, or hardware problems. A displayed pump state is not a guarantee that a relay or pump is physically operating. Hardware safety behavior, including tank-full or leak overrides, may stop equipment even when the app requests operation.

4. Monitoring and water-quality information
Sensor readings and safety labels are informational estimates based on the available sensors and data. They are not laboratory analysis, certification, a guarantee of potability, or professional engineering, plumbing, health, or water-treatment advice. Do not drink, distribute, or use water based only on an in-app reading. Use appropriate laboratory testing and consult qualified professionals where safety, health, building, or regulatory decisions are involved.

5. Filter-life estimates
Filter-health and remaining-life information is an estimate produced from sensor readings, runtime information, configured assumptions, and, where applicable, simulated or nominal telemetry. It is not a substitute for inspection, cleaning, replacement, manufacturer instructions, or a qualified technician. You remain responsible for maintaining and replacing filter media at appropriate intervals.

You must not circumvent authentication or safety controls; access another person's account or equipment without permission; interfere with the service or its data; introduce malicious code; misuse remote commands; or use the service in a way that could injure a person, damage property, contaminate water, or disrupt another user's system.

HYDROSENSE PRIVACY POLICY

Provider: Group 1
Contact: ciriloenriquez123@gmail.com
Effective date: October 15, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Group 1 handles information used by HydroSense. By using HydroSense, you acknowledge this Policy. It should be read together with the Terms and Conditions.

1. Information we may handle
Account information: When you register or sign in, HydroSense may handle your email address, display name, Firebase user identifier, authentication provider, and profile information made available by Google or Facebook when you choose those sign-in methods.

Water-system information: HydroSense may receive and display data sent by your connected system, including pH, TDS, turbidity, tank level, tank distance, tank warnings, leak or moisture status, pump statuses, control-mode information, pump runtime counters, and other supported sensor or hardware values.

Filter and app information: The app may store filter-health estimates, filter service actions, model observations, consent status, selected language, theme preference, saved-account display information, and other settings needed to provide the requested features. Some of this information is stored locally on your device.

Technical and security information: Firebase and other service providers may process technical information needed to authenticate users, maintain connections, protect the service, prevent abuse, diagnose failures, and deliver their services.

2. How information is collected
Information may come from you during registration or account use, from Google or Facebook when you select their sign-in options, from Firebase Authentication, from your connected ESP32 or other supported hardware, and from your device while the app is running.

3. How we use information
Group 1 may use information to create and secure accounts; authenticate users; display live monitoring data; send and reflect authorized control commands; provide tank, leak, pump, and filter features; calculate filter-health estimates; remember settings and saved accounts; respond to support or deletion requests; maintain, secure, troubleshoot, and improve HydroSense; and comply with legal obligations.

4. Services and sharing
HydroSense relies on Firebase Authentication and Realtime Database services to support accounts and synchronized monitoring or control data. If you choose Google or Facebook sign-in, the selected provider processes information under its own terms and privacy policy. Group 1 may share information with service providers that help operate HydroSense, when required by law, to protect rights and safety, or as part of a lawful business reorganization. Group 1 does not sell your personal information.

5. Connected-system access
Information written to the connected system or Firebase database may be accessible to authorized users and the hardware configured for your account. Do not connect equipment or share account access unless you are authorized to do so. Group 1 cannot control what another authorized person does with data or hardware access.

6. Storage and retention
Account and system data may remain in Firebase while your account or the connected service is active, or for as long as reasonably needed for security, legal, backup, dispute, and operational purposes. Consent records, settings, saved-account metadata, and filter history may remain on your device until you clear them, remove the app, use an available reset feature, or request assistance. Deleting the app does not by itself delete Firebase account or system data.

7. Security
Group 1 uses reasonable measures available within the app and its configured services to protect information. No internet transmission, authentication system, database, device, or physical installation is completely secure. You are responsible for protecting your credentials, devices, network, and connected equipment.

8. Your choices and requests
You may stop using a sign-in provider, update information supported by the app, remove saved-account information from the device, or contact Group 1 at ciriloenriquez123@gmail.com to ask about access, correction, deletion, or other privacy concerns. We may need to verify your identity before completing a request. Removing consent or deleting account data may prevent some HydroSense features from working. Requests remain subject to information that Group 1 must retain under applicable law or for legitimate security, backup, or dispute purposes.

9. Adults only
HydroSense is intended for people who are at least 18 years old. We do not knowingly invite children under 18 to create accounts. If you believe a person under 18 provided information, contact Group 1 so the matter can be reviewed.

10. Changes to this Policy
Group 1 may update this Privacy Policy when the app, services, or legal requirements change. The effective date identifies the current version. Where required, HydroSense will ask users to review and acknowledge an updated Policy.

11. Contact
For privacy questions, data requests, or concerns about HydroSense, contact Group 1 at ciriloenriquez123@gmail.com. This Policy is governed by applicable laws of the Philippines, subject to any mandatory rights that apply to you.
